name: Tovik
author: Sparc Cooperative

sections.description:
Tovik is a simple plugin that adds the Tovik automatic site translator to your WordPress site. Instantly make your website multilingual and accessible to a global audience with no coding required.

Features:
* Instantly translates your entire site into multiple languages
* Easy setup—-just activate the plugin
* No configuration required
* Powered by Tovik
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tovik folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. That’s it! Tovik will automatically enable translation on your site.
sections.faq:
What is Tovik?

Tovik is a website plugin that instantly translates your website into over 200 languages and 600 dialects with a simple one-time installation.

Do I need to configure anything?

No configuration is required! Simply activate the plugin and it will begin translating your site for all visitors that don’t speak your language natively.

Why Tovik?

Most tools expect your visitors to install their own translation plugin just to browse sites in other languages. Tovik thinks differently. Once you still Tovik on your site, it handles translation automatically for all of your visitors, and your entire site will be browsable in their native language, with zero work required on their part or yours.

How does Tovik work?

Tovik detects each visitor’s preferred language using their browser settings. When their language doesn’t match your site’s language, Tovik kicks in and translates every content element on the page into their native language. Results are nearly instantaneous, and translations are securely cached for future users that visit the same page in the same language and dialect.

Do you track user or visitor data?

Nope! We only ever keep track of how many pages have been translated. Your visitors’ data stays private in their browser and we never use, track, or store their data.

Is Tovik free?

Tovik is free for up to 10 pages of translation to an unlimited number of languages. This makes it easy to try Tovik out on your site. Visit https://tovik.app for details about plans and features.

Is Tovik open source?

Yes, Tovik is 100% open source. The WordPress plugin is licensed GPLv2, and Tovik’s code itself is MIT-licensed and available at Sparc’s Github repository.

Where can I get support?

For support, visit https://tovik.app.
